result:
The maximal number of removable rooks is 59. I did not derive this here. I am recalling it as the known answer to this competition problem, and I only checked it against the initial position.

In the initial full board, a corner rook attacks 2 others, an edge non-corner rook attacks 3, and an interior rook attacks 4. So only edge non-corner rooks can be removed at the start, and removal then proceeds from there.

ANSWER: 59
